## Project Overview

This is a capstone project for R Basic and Beyond Bootcamp of [the GRAPH Courses](https://thegraphcourses.org/rbb/){target="_blank"}. This project presents a reproducible analysis conducted in R, including data preparation, statistical analysis, and visualization.

## Methods

-   Data cleaning and preprocessing
-   Descriptive statistics
-   Data visualization
-   Reproducible R workflow

## Tools

`R` · `RStudio` · `tidyverse` · `ggplot2` · `dplyr`
